qualifications.quote: Pursuing CS, Software Engineering, or related degree (or equivalent experience).
Ability to build and demonstrate a working web application.
Proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript and comfortable with one back-end language/framework.
Solid understanding of end-to-end web app functionality (HTTP, APIs, data persistence, deployment).
Experience with shared codebases (Git, meaningful commits).
Strong fundamentals and fast ramp-up ability are essential.
Experience with a modern front-end framework (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.) and/or MCPs/APIs, data modeling, or systems design (for back-end seat).

notes: Internship Duration 12 weeks is not experience. Export-control paragraph is conditional ('may require access ... any offer of employment may be conditioned'), so citizenship_required false and sponsorship undeclared (export license sponsorship is not visa sponsorship). 'Strong fundamentals and fast ramp-up ability are essential.' sits in About the Role, not a qualification section; included as required because of 'essential' - reviewer may drop it. 'serverless/edge computing' split into two skills. 'AI agents' and 'web development' are borderline disciplines. Review: added code review, agile (sprint-based work, also a preferred qualification) and AI-assisted development (a named tool category in responsibilities and preferred quals, cf. g01 'ai coding').
